# Synthetic room-observation fixtures

**Not observations. No price here was collected.** Generated by
`npm run fixtures:room-panel` (scripts/room-panel-fixtures.mjs); `scripts/room-panel-fixtures.test.mjs`
fails if a file drifts from what the generator produces.

Each `{city}/{date}.json` starts from the research packet's own `template()` for the
frozen panel and is saved the way the entry form's Download button saves it
(`{ ...round, coverage }`). Each `{date}.check.json` is what `check.mjs` prints for that
file, computed with "now" = 2026-11-18T12:00Z (the real CLI would reject today's clock
and the missing evidence images).

| City | Scenario | Band |
|---|---|---|
| Vienna | 16/16 quotes, 10 tax-included / 6 silent | ±25% |
| London | 12/12 quotes, all silent | ±35% |
| Milan | one sold out, one identified checkout; non-refundable and breakfast fallbacks | 7/7 → ±30% |
| Barcelona | 16/16, all stated-extra with a stated amount; one hotel with an itemized embedded charge | ±25% |
| Istanbul | 5 weekend stays unavailable → 8/3 | refused |
